_comment: Copy this file to ep-006-<slug>.json. Files starting with '_' are skipped by validators and publishers. Set status to 'ready' only after fact_check.verified is true.

fact_check.claim: The single factual claim the payoff depends on
fact_check.source_hint: Where to verify it (primary source preferred)

hooks: Hook B: number or you-test, <= 12 words

beats.vo: Spoken line. About 2.3-2.8 words per second.
beats.visual: What changes on screen in this beat

beats.vo: Open the loop. Promise, don't deliver.

payoff: The one sentence that closes the loop
cta: One binary question, answerable in one word
pinned_comment: Channel's own first comment: a low-effort binary question
description: First line restates the hook. Then 1-2 lines of context. Then the CTA question. Then credits/source hints.

thumbnail.prompt: Optional art-direction note for a generated or designed thumbnail
